newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire orders arrest of rebel leader Kabila.
newsitem.headline: Zaire orders arrest of rebel leader Kabila.

text.p: Zaire on Tuesday issued an arrest warrant for the leader of the Tutsi rebel group that has taken over part of its eastern borderland, national radio said.
"An arrest warrant has been issued for the delinquent, Laurent Kabila, who is guilty of attempting to destabilise the interior of the country," the radio said.
Kabila's Rwandan-backed forces have routed the Zaire army since the rebels launched an armed campaign a month ago, ostensibly to defend the citizenship rights of ethnic Tutsis.
The radio did not say how authorities intended to go about arresting Kabile.
